subject: POC Launch Plan & Success Criteria — BrightOps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightops.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Launch Plan & Success Criteria — BrightOps

Hi Samira — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the trial kickoff. Please confirm or edit anything I got wrong.

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: reduce query latency across BrightOps customer-facing search by 30% while keeping relevance stable.
- Scope: 4 representative queries + two high-volume templates; ~1M tokens/day estimated traffic during test window.
- Must-haves: VPC deployment, redaction of PII in logs, token-level billing visibility.

Proposed POC success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: median tail latency improvement >= 25% across the 4 queries measured at 95th percentile.
2) Relevance: no more than a 3% drop in precision@10 on your canonical test set.
3) Reliability: <1% error rate over a 72-hour validation window.
4) Security: audit logs and KMS integration verified in pre-prod.

Evaluation plan and timeline
- Week 0 (Mar 8): Environment prep. BrightOps to provide sample dataset + access details (S3 path, VPC peering window).
- Week 1 (Mar 15): Ingest sample data, baseline run on BrightOps infra, Redwood deploys model variant and KV cache config.
- Week 2 (Mar 22): Load validation and 72-hour continuous run. Collect metrics and qualitative feedback.
- Week 3 (Mar 29): Post-POC review; decision on next steps (scale, dedicated pool, contract).

Ownership & contacts
- BrightOps: Samira Khan (POC lead), Procurement (procurement@brightops.com)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, program owner), Sergio Alvarez (SE, infra & SLOs), Dev Patel (integration lead), Monica Patel (CS onboarding).

Immediate asks (can we confirm these by Friday?):
- Samira: provide the sample dataset link + IPs/subnets for VPC peering.
- Procurement: confirm standard NDA + timeline for PO (if inevitable).
- Internal: Sergio/Dev — confirm resource availability for week-of-Mar-15 baseline runs.

Attachments: I attached a short Redwood POC checklist; feel free to add any BrightOps docs in reply.

Thanks again — I’ll wait for confirmation and we’ll lock the kickoff date.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: POC Launch Plan & Success Criteria — BrightOps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches our internal thinking. A few clarifications / tweaks below.

Confirmed success criteria
- Latency target: let’s aim for >=30% improvement at p95 if possible; 25% is acceptable as a minimum.
- Relevance: we’ll run our canonical relevance set (attached) and also sample user sessions for qualitative checks.
- Reliability/security: agreed on KMS + redaction; we need to validate that logs do not contain raw PII before exporting.

Timeline note
- We’re tight on calendar the week of Mar 15 due to a planned maintenance window. Could we shift the baseline run to Mar 16–18? We still want the full 72-hour run the following week (Mar 22–24).

Data/Access (action)
- Attachment: BrightOps_POC_requirements.xlsx — includes S3 paths, data sample, and the canonical relevance set.
- I’ve opened a ticket with our infra team to approve VPC peering; expected approval by end of day Mon Mar 8.

Procurement
- procurement@brightops.com: we’ll need a short MSA; happy to start with your standard trial SOW. No PO required to begin the POC, but procurement wants a non-binding SOW for audit.

Thanks, will confirm peering once infra replies.

—Samira
Samira Khan

samira@brightops.ai

Subject: Re: POC Launch Plan & Success Criteria — BrightOps

All — quick technical alignment. Thanks Samira for the requirements doc. A few notes from the SE side and proposed tasks for the internal runbook.

Technical checklist (internal)
- Confirm model variant: propose "redwood-rlhf-3b-q4" for the baseline; will also stage a quantized variant if peak memory is a constraint.
- KV cache: we’ll enable prefix caching for the top 50 queries and autorewrite TTL to 24h for the test window.
- Observability: set up token-level traces + per-route dashboards in the Console; enable 48h retention for the trial logs.

Pre-prod tasks (assigned)
- Dev Patel: request VPC peering creds from BrightOps, validate S3 access, run an initial data sanity check (Mar 9–11).
- Sergio Alvarez: provision the dedicated test instance and baseline configuration (Mar 12–15).
- Monica Patel: prepare onboarding docs + test-playbook; will run the end-user acceptance checklist during the 72-hour run.

SOW & legal
- Marissa: can you share a short trial SOW with procurement? I’ve drafted a 1-page scope that we can attach to the HubSpot deal; happy to send it if useful.

No blockers from infra on our side — we’ll hold the baseline until peering is confirmed. If BrightOps prefers Mar 16 baseline, we can shift.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick weekly status and a couple of nudges to keep us on schedule. Quoting the relevant thread below for context.

Status update
- Infra peering: BrightOps infra confirmed peering on Mar 9 (thanks Samira). Dev completed data sanity checks on Mar 10; no sensitive fields surfaced in exports.
- Provisioning: Sergio provisioned the test instance on Mar 12; baseline config staged.
- Baseline run: shifted to Mar 16–18 per Samira; baseline complete. Initial p95 latency improvement: 28% (preliminary).

Open items (asks this week)
1) Samira: can you share the canonical user-session samples by EOD Thu Mar 19 so Monica can start qualitative checks?
2) Procurement: can you review the short trial SOW I uploaded to the HubSpot deal (link below) and confirm no changes needed for this test scope?
3) Internal: Sergio/Dev — after the 72-hour run ends today, can you bundle the per-route traces and a brief anomaly summary by end-of-day Fri Mar 19?

Links & artifacts
- HubSpot SOW (draft): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BRIGHT-4382
- Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_poc-kickoff

If there are no objections I’ll schedule the post-POC review for Tue Mar 23 at 10am PT (30 min). Please accept or propose alternatives.

Thanks — we’re in a good spot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
